title: Resume — one-column CV renderer
description: A clean one-column résumé / CV app: name, roles, location, contact row, summary, skills, experience (role · org · period + bullet points) and projects. The data is INJECTED via a single ResumeProfile seam — call configureResume(myProfile) at boot to render your own person (Convex query, CMS, a JSON file), or keep the bundled generic placeholder profile so it renders fully populated with zero backend. A 'Print / PDF' button calls window.print() against a print-friendly layout.
